name: Trout of Order
source:
Play as Gina, an office worker who likes marine biology -- and her beautiful co-worker Quinn Brown! (Un)Luckily, she gets stuck with an elevator with her, and now it's up to her to make sure she doesn't pass by her dream girl. 

[From [url=https://marchenhare.itch.io/troutoforder]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演喜欢海洋生物学的办公室职员吉娜（Gina）和她美丽的同事奎因·布朗（Quinn Brown）！（Un）幸运的是，她被困在电梯里，现在她得确保自己不会与她的梦中情人擦肩而过。

[来自[url=https://marchenhare.itch.io/troutoforder]itch.io[/url]]
